caption: The video captures an elevated daytime view of a sandy beach and open ocean under a clear blue sky, filmed from a pier in Ocean City, Maryland. A large curved shadow fills the lower-left, while rectangular shadows and a railing line the right edge, and text overlays sit top-right and bottom-left. The horizon and framing stay essentially constant. The main visible process is the ocean surf, where white foam bands continuously advance, break, and retreat, shifting shape and position. A bird with spread wings briefly crosses the right portion over the water-beach boundary. Scattered small figures rest or move on the sand, and a faint point hangs high in the sky. The breaking lines and foam near the waterline keep rearranging throughout.
